items.q: The constraints x ≥ 0 and y ≥ 0 limit the region to the:
items.qAf: Die beperkings x ≥ 0 en y ≥ 0 beperk die gebied tot die:
items.explain: Both coordinates are non-negative, which is the first quadrant.
items.explainAf: Albei koördinate is nie-negatief, wat die eerste kwadrant is.

items.q: Is the point (3, 4) feasible under the constraint x + y ≤ 10?
items.qAf: Is die punt (3, 4) toelaatbaar onder die beperking x + y ≤ 10?
items.explain: 3 + 4 = 7 ≤ 10, so the point satisfies the constraint.
items.explainAf: 3 + 4 = 7 ≤ 10, dus voldoen die punt aan die beperking.

items.q: Which point is a vertex of the region x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0, x + y ≤ 10?
items.qAf: Watter punt is ’n hoekpunt van die gebied x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0, x + y ≤ 10?
items.explain: (10, 0) lies on the boundaries x + y = 10 and y = 0, so it is a corner point.
items.explainAf: (10, 0) lê op die grense x + y = 10 en y = 0, dus is dit ’n hoekpunt.

items.q: Maximise P = 3x + 2y over the region with vertices (0, 0), (10, 0) and (0, 10). What is the maximum?
items.qAf: Maksimeer P = 3x + 2y oor die gebied met hoekpunte (0, 0), (10, 0) en (0, 10). Wat is die maksimum?
items.explain: At (0, 0) P = 0, at (10, 0) P = 30, at (0, 10) P = 20. The maximum is 30.
items.explainAf: By (0, 0) is P = 0, by (10, 0) is P = 30, by (0, 10) is P = 20. Die maksimum is 30.

items.q: Minimise C = 2x + 5y over the vertices (0, 4), (6, 0) and (2, 2). What is the minimum?
items.qAf: Minimeer C = 2x + 5y oor die hoekpunte (0, 4), (6, 0) en (2, 2). Wat is die minimum?
items.explain: C = 20 at (0, 4), 12 at (6, 0) and 14 at (2, 2). The minimum is 12.
items.explainAf: C = 20 by (0, 4), 12 by (6, 0) en 14 by (2, 2). Die minimum is 12.

items.q: The optimal solution of a linear programme occurs at:
items.qAf: Die optimale oplossing van ’n lineêre program kom voor by:
options: a vertex of the feasible region
items.explain: The objective function is linear, so its extreme values occur at the corner points.
items.explainAf: Die doelfunksie is lineêr, dus kom die uiterste waardes by die hoekpunte voor.
